statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and unexplained syncope
There is concern for underlying arrhythmia
The patient has an established diagnosis of sick sinus syndrome (I49.5)
The service is to correlate symptomatic events with potential bradyarrhythmic episodes
The diagnoses of R42 and R55 are supported
The denial reason is CO-97 (service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable)
